name: KOReader
subtitle: An e-book reader for many formats
description: KOReader is a free e-book and document reader. It opens EPUB, PDF, CBZ and many other formats, and it runs on many e-readers. Store lists KOReader as a reference. Install it from KOReader's own site to see it on your PrimitiveOS home screen.

changes.notes: Not installed by the store. Its own install steps are on koreader.rocks.

versions.notes: Listed for reference; the store does not download or install it.
